Synopsis:
A Russian drone strike on an ammunition depot in Myla, near Kyiv, killed 38 people — the deadliest Russian strike of the year. Secondary explosions devastated a civilian neighborhood. Zelenskiy attributed the casualties to official negligence in storing munitions near homes. Russia has intensified its air campaign, deploying nearly 2,000 drones, 1,600+ bombs, and 31 missiles in a single week. Cleanup and missing-persons searches are ongoing, with significant contamination reported.
